To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the overexpression of the soybean transcription factor GmNFYA1 enhances drought tolerance in transgenic Arabiopsis and soybean.

overexpression of NFYA5 in Arabidopsis plants decreased the stomatal aperture and transpiration rate and enhanced drought tolerance, and overexpression and suppression of NFYA5 increased and decreased drought stress tolerance, respectively, in soybean plants.
overexpression of soybean NF-YA5 gene (GmNFYA5) in transgenic Arabiopsis plants and soybean plants conferred drought tolerance to transgenics.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of GmNFYAs in the regulation of drought tolerance in soybeans.
the role of GmNFY5 in drought tolerance in soybeans.
GmNFYA gene and the mechanism of its action in the regulation of soybean drought resistance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the GmNF-YA5 protein is a transcription factor that can bind to the promoter of GmDreB2 and GMBZIP1 genes and increase their transcriptional activity under drought stress.
overexpression of soybean NF-YA5 gene in transgenic soybean plants confers drought tolerance by enhancing the expression of multiple genes in ABA-dependent and -independent pathways.
overexpression of NF-YA gene GmNF-YA5 in Arabidopsis and transgenic soybean plants improved drought tolerance by regulating the expression of drought-responsive genes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
GmNFYA3, GmNFYA6, GmNFYB3 and GmNFYC2 were involved in drought tolerance in soybeans.
GmNFYA1-5 and their homologs in different plants might have the same function in response to abiotic stresses, and GmNFYA2 and GmNFYB2 might be involved in the regulation of GmNFYAs.
GmNFYA1, GmNFYA3 and GmNFYA4 may play a role in the drought stress tolerance, while GmNFYA2, GmNFYa5, GmNFYB2 and GmA2 may play a role during the seed development.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the GmNFY5 gene can be used to enhance drought tolerance in soybeans.
overexpression of the NF-YA5 gene from soybean confers drought tolerance in transgenic Arababidopsis and soyabean plants.
overexpression of the soybean NF-YA5 gene in transgenic soybean and Arabidopsis plants improved tolerance to drought stress.
